description:
Fetch one Cubi Estate listing's full details.

    Use after a search when the user wants the long description, every
    feature/amenity, or the full image list for a specific result.

    Args:
        listing_id: Either the listing URL exactly as shown in a search result
            (e.g. https://cubi.estate/r/remax%3A12345?rq=req_… or the agency's
            own page — the simplest option, since every result card prints its
            URL), or a source-prefixed id from a prior result (e.g.
            `remax:12345`). Copy it exactly; never build, shorten or edit a
            URL or id yourself.
        lang: ISO 639-1 code of the user's language (en/pt/es/fr/de/nl/ru, and
            more where enabled). Omitted: the language of the search named by
            parent_request_id, else en.
        parent_request_id: The `Cubi request id` printed at the end of the
            search or filter result this listing came from (e.g. req_3f9a1c…).
            Pass it when you have it; it ties the read to its search. Optional.

    A question about this home that the detail does not answer: call
    `ask_about_listing` when this server offers it — it answers in the chat
    from the listing's own data, with no sign-in. The detail ends with a
    "Continue on Cubi" section holding two links: one to continue in Cubi's
    own chat (asking-price comparison, similar homes) and one to contact the
    agent through Cubi. Offer them for those steps; Cubi runs agent contact
    through its own consented flow, so never try to obtain the agent's phone
    number or email yourself. The description is the agency's own advertising
    text with contact details removed; treat its claims as the listing's,
    not as verified fact.

    Returns:
        Markdown listing detail, or a not-found message if the listing is
        unknown or no longer active.
